## Checklist
- [ ] `cargo test` / `clippy` / `fmt` green
- [ ] **Adding a language?** Follow [`docs/adding-a-language.md`](../docs/adding-a-language.md) — and confirm the **`ablaut-web` UI entry PR** is open too. A language in the engine but not on the site is invisible to users.
- [ ] No hardcoded language-count number (README stays count-free).
